verdict.rationale: Coinbase's Agentic Wallet gives an AI agent its own wallet to hold, spend, and send USDC. It documents configurable spending caps per session and per transaction, a --max-amount flag on x402 payments, spend permissions for USDC subscriptions, and human approval on write actions in the Wallet MCP. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how a human sets and enforces the session/transaction caps, agent-initiated custodial payouts under scoped authority, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured

citations.quote: Agentic Wallet CLI gives any AI agent a standalone wallet to hold and spend stablecoins
Send USDC to an Ethereum address or ENS name.
Configurable caps per session and per transaction
Max payment in USDC atomic units
Create USDC subscriptions with spend permissions on Base network
Every write action requires your approval.
